models_evaluated: machine learning remote acuity prediction algorithm (virtual triage)

links.outcome: Agreement of algorithm-predicted acuity with nurse eCTAS triage scores on local retrospective ED data
links.effect: Exact agreement 48.4%; kappa 0.18 unweighted, 0.25 linear-weighted, 0.36 quadratic-weighted; overtriaged 46.1%, undertriaged 5.5%. Algorithm needs refinement before safe use.
links.quote: This machine learning algorithm needs further refinement before being safely implemented for patient use.

links.outcome: Under-triage and over-triage of remote acuity predictions versus nurse triage
links.effect: Overtriaged 9,897 (46.1%) and undertriaged 1,176 (5.5%) cases; undertriaged complaints included abnormal lab/imaging results, visual disturbance, and fever.
links.quote: Using the nurse-led eCTAS score as the reference, the machine learning algorithm overtriaged 9,897 (46.1%) and undertriaged 1,176 (5.5%) cases.

screen.reason: The study evaluates the reliability and safety (over-triage vs under-triage) of an existing machine learning triage algorithm on retrospective ED patient records compared to nurse triage scores, but does not test a specific deployment practice or safeguard.
